tools.name: check_payee
tools.description: Payee risk check. Screens a payee wallet address and name against the OFAC SDN sanctions list and checks the merchant domain's registration age and DNS. Returns risk low|medium|high|unknown with flags such as sanctioned_address, sanctioned_name_possible, new_domain. Use for standalone payee screenin

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Cached x402 endpoint observations, operated by SpendPreflight. Returns a transparent score (or unknown), its components and seven-day unpaid probe history for an already publicly listed URL. Never fetches the caller's URL or pays the endpoint. tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Free, read-only service reference. Use first to learn prices, default spending rules, payment setup, trial allowance, and integration links. Takes no arguments and performs no payee screening or payment decision. Use check_payee for standalone payee risk; use preflight_payment for an x402 challenge

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_payee, check_endpoint · Private data: check_payee, preflight_payment, check_endpoint · Public sink: preflight_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_payee, check_endpoint · Private data: check_payee, preflight_payment, check_endpoint · Public sink: preflight_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "preflight_payment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
